description: §17.6 Example 6 verbatim in shape — two `lift` statements on the same execution path of one if-as-expression arm SHALL be E-LIFT-002. Before s456 codegen detected the shape but only wrote a `/* E-LIFT-002 … */` comment into the artifact; the compile exited 0.
rationale: §10 / §17.6: in value-lift mode `lift` SHALL appear at most once on any execution path through an arm body; two or more reachable `lift` statements on the same path SHALL emit E-LIFT-002 (§34 row: Error).
